Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scope — Covers the dimensions of the following types of case pipes for wrist watch case: 

Type A — Without steps 

Type B — With step outside 

Type C — With step outside and counterbore

Note — Dimensions /i and /a may be suitably chosen to get the desired value of h* 

3. Designation 

3.1 A case pipe of Type A having outside diameter di = 25 mm, bore diameter d* ~ 1*5 mm and 
total length k = 3'1 mm shall be designated as: 

Case Pipe A 2*5 x 15 x 3'1 IS : 9642 

3.2 A case pipe of Type B having outside diameter di — 2'5 mm, pipe projecting length 1% = 1*9 mm, 
fitting diameter d* = 1*8 mm, fitting length 1% = 14 mm and bore diameter cf2 = 1"5 mm shall be 
designated as: 

Case Pipe B 2*5 x 1*9 X 1'8 x 1*4 x 1*5 IS : 9642 

3.3 A case pipe of Type C hav'rng outside diameter d% = 2*5 mm, pipe projecting length k = 19 mm, 
fitting diameter dz = V8 mm, fitting length k = V4 mm, inner hole diameter di = V3 mm, counter- 
bore depth U = 1*7 mm and bore diameter c/ 2 = 1 '5 mm shall be designated as: 

Case Pipe C 2"5 x 1*9 x 1*8 X 1*4 X 1*3 x 1*7 x 1*5 IS : 9642 

4. Material — Nickel silver ( copper nickel zinc alloy ). 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of the series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch case. In the 
preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from DIN 8296-1971 Sleeves for winding 
buttons of wrist watches. Deutsches Institut fur Normung.
